title: An Asymptotic Theory of Chain-of-Thought in In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03217v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become a widely used mechanism for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models by generating intermediate reasoning steps at inference time. Yet the scaling behavior of generalization with CoT depth remains poorly understood. To address this question, we study a theoretically solvable model of CoT for in-context weight prediction in linear regression, where test-time reasoning is represented as an iterative refinement of the weight-parameter estimate. Using tools from random matrix theory under high-dimensional asymptotics, we derive an exact formula for the generalization error as a function of reasoning depth, pretraining data amount, and context length. Our analysis reveals a sharp phase transition separating exponential and polynomial improvement, saturation, and overthinking, and characterizes how the optimal reasoning depth scales. translated_title: 上下文学习中思维链的渐近理论
translated_abstract: 思维链推理已成为一种广泛使用的机制，通过在推理时生成中间推理步骤来激发大型语言模型的多步推理能力。然而，泛化性能随CoT深度的缩放行为仍然知之甚少。为解答这一问题，我们研究了线性回归中用于上下文权重预测的CoT理论可解模型，其中测试时推理被表示为权重参数估计的迭代精化过程。利用高维渐近条件下的随机矩阵理论工具，我们推导出了泛化误差关于推理深度、预训练数据量和上下文长度的精确公式。我们的分析揭示了一个清晰的相变，将指数级改进、多项式级改进、饱和以及过度思考区分开来，并刻画了最优推理深度的缩放方式。我们进一步表明，更深的推理在……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了上下文学习中思维链推理的首个渐近理论，精确推导出泛化误差随推理深度、预训练数据量和上下文长度变化的公式，并揭示了指数级与多项式级改进、饱和和过度思考之间的相变及最优推理深度的缩放规律。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an asymptotic theory of chain-of-thought in in-context learning, deriving an exact formula for generalization error as a function of reasoning depth, pretraining data, and context length, and revealing a sharp phase transition between exponential and polynomial improvement, saturation, and overthinking, as well as how the optimal reasoning depth scales.
